notes_for_editor: Build year 1958 is in all three pages (Register, firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts). The 1930s tent camp has no exact year, so it is not an event. Elevation disagrees: Register 9,097 ft (record 2,772.8 m) vs firelookout.com 9,235 ft; the Register figure is kept, unresolved. Wood vs treated timber left open (Register says wood; the other two say treated). Height 3.05 m is 10 feet from the sources; the record's 3.0 m was not changed. 'Last used for emergencies in the late 1960s' is the only use source; the staffing status 'no longer staffed' is our reading of it, not a source phrase. Two web searches gave a 1957 build date and a Big Sky location; neither was cited because those pages were not read. No source read says whether the cab is open to visitors. No photos found with image URLs. Not verified: current condition.
